summary: All 5 review items PASSED end-to-end. Backend pytest 8/8 in /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py (new_features_results.xml): (a) purchase-limit enforcement returns 409 LIMIT_REACHED with detail.code=LIMIT_REACHED and detail.message containing 'DO NOT BUY'; override=true bypasses; (b) batch-buy simulation (3 x /api/buy with override=false) all return 409, stock_count stays at 1; (c) POST /api/auth/change-password → wrong current=400 (Gujarati 'વર્તમાન password ખોટો છે'), short new (<6)=422, same-as-old=422, valid change + revert to Salam@123 works and login succeeds with new & old (reverted); (d) POST /api/upload returns {path,url:/api/files/...}; (e) POST /api/buy with photos:[path] & location.gps persists — GET /api/parts/{pn} returns unit.location.gps and unit.photos containing the uploaded path. Frontend (Expo web, 390x844, admin abdul/Salam@123): (1) Admin tab → ACCOUNT → 'Password બદલો' link (testID=admin-link-change-password) navigates to /change-password; cp-current/cp-new/cp-confirm/cp-save all render; submitting wrong current pw triggers Gujarati toast (backend 400) verified visually. (2) Set part-limit=1 via API then open /buy?pn=<pn>: DO NOT BUY banner ([data-testid=do-not-buy]) visible, confirm-buy label = 'BLOCKED — Limit Reached', aria-disabled=true. (3) /batch-buy header subtitle correctly shows 'GPS…' marker (GPS status displayed). Adding the limited PN via batch-manual+batch-add → server 409 (console error), row NOT added to list, Total remains 0 (frontend correctly ignores 409 and does not increment), server-side stock_count stayed at 1. Fresh PN still adds successfully. (4) /buy PART PHOTOS card visible with buy-take-photo, buy-pick-gallery, 0/6 counter; gps-synced row rendered (fetching text in headless — acceptable). (5) /part/<pn> STOCK UNITS row displays GPS coordinate '21.170200,72.831100' correctly after a buy with location.gps. Admin password unchanged post-test (login as Salam@123 returns 200). One benign console warning persists: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' from batch-buy web overlay (already reported in iteration_10).
